title: MatMix Solo #24 (새 재질 솔로 · 산호·조개 붉은 산호 · 체형 BBW bombshell · 인종 ebony · 메이크업 비주얼계 블랙립 5단계 · 극한 · 배경 대리석 홀 · 힐 숫자 없음 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, late 20s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, shaggy layered dark brown hair — full body carved deep red coral and iridescent mother-of-pearl fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid coral and shell curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted coral sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep red branching coral relief across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID iridescent pearl-white nacre sections shimmering pink and gold between the coral, with mother-of-pearl flowers inlaid into the sections, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: leaning a shoulder against the doorway, one knee bent, a hand on her thigh — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of the same coral and mother-of-pearl, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her whole hand, made of the same coral and mother-of-pearl with a high polish.
Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and heavy gold rings on every finger. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT coral — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: heavily smudged black eyeshadow blazing from the lash line up to the temples, thick smeared black liner all around the eyes, clumped black lashes top and bottom, fully opaque saturated jet-black lips, deeply shadowed black contour under the cheekbones.

Background: a bright grand hall with a pale marble floor, tall columns, standard-height arched doors and soft golden daylight, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
